zh.title: 737-8 丹佛重落地起落架受損 FAA、NTSB 聯合調查中
zh.summary: 一架波音737-8今晨於丹佛國際機場降落時疑因風切重落地，右主起落架受損，機上142人無人受傷。FAA 已調閱塔台通話與飛航資料。
body: 當地時間今晨7時許，一架執飛芝加哥—丹佛航線的波音737-8在丹佛國際機場34L跑道降落時重落地，右主起落架支柱受損，飛機滑行至滑行道後停止。機上136名乘客與6名機組人員均安全下機，無人受傷。
初步資料顯示，落地當時機場周邊出現明顯風切警告，前一架進場航機曾執行重飛。FAA 已調閱塔台通話紀錄與 ADS-B 資料，NTSB 亦派遣現場調查小組。
涉事飛機機齡3.2年。航空公司表示將全力配合調查，該機於現場完成初步檢查後拖回維修棚。丹佛機場34L跑道關閉約2小時後重開，連帶影響約60班航班。
本起事件初步歸類為「嚴重事件（serious incident）」，調查初步報告預計30天內公布。

en.title: Boeing 737-8 gear damaged in Denver hard landing; FAA and NTSB investigating
en.summary: A 737-8 suffered right main-gear damage in a suspected wind-shear hard landing at Denver this morning. All 142 aboard were unhurt; the FAA has pulled tower tapes and flight data.
body: A Boeing 737-8 operating Chicago–Denver made a hard landing on Denver runway 34L around 7 a.m. local time, damaging the right main-gear strut before stopping on a taxiway. All 136 passengers and six crew deplaned safely.
Preliminary data show wind-shear alerts around the field at the time; the preceding arrival had gone around. The FAA has secured tower recordings and ADS-B data, and the NTSB dispatched a go-team.

The 3.2-year-old aircraft will be hangared after on-site inspection. Runway 34L reopened after about two hours, affecting some 60 flights. The occurrence is preliminarily classed as a serious incident, with an initial report expected within 30 days.

zh.title: ICAO 通過 CORSIA 2026 修訂指引 SAF 憑證首度納入計算
zh.summary: ICAO 理事會通過國際航空碳抵換與減量計畫修訂版，更新合格碳權清單與 MRV 規範，2027 年 1 月生效。
body: ICAO 理事會通過 CORSIA（國際航空碳抵換與減量計畫）2026 年版修訂指引，更新合格排放單位清單與監測、報告及查證（MRV）規範，並訂於2027年1月生效。
修訂重點包括收緊合格碳權標準、簡化小型營運人申報流程，並首度納入永續航空燃料（SAF）憑證的計算方法。
IATA 對修訂表示歡迎，但提醒各國主管機關需同步更新國內法規，避免營運人面臨雙重申報負擔。

en.title: ICAO adopts 2026 CORSIA amendments; SAF credits enter the accounting
en.summary: The Council updated eligible emissions units and MRV rules, effective January 2027.
body: The ICAO Council adopted the 2026 amendments to CORSIA, updating the eligible emissions-units list and monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) provisions, effective January 2027.

Key changes tighten carbon-credit eligibility, simplify filings for small operators, and for the first time define an accounting method for sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) certificates. IATA welcomed the revision while urging states to align national rules to avoid double reporting.

zh.title: IATA：6 月全球客運需求年增 8.2% 亞太線以 11.6% 領漲
zh.summary: 6 月 RPK 年增 8.2%，載客率 84.9% 創同期新高；亞太—北美航線表現最強。
body: IATA 公布最新數據：6月全球客運需求（RPK）年增8.2%，其中亞太區以11.6%領先所有區域；整體載客率84.9%，創6月同期新高。
國際線需求年增9.4%，亞太—北美航線受惠於運能恢復與匯率因素表現最強；國內線市場成長5.1%。
IATA 理事長指出，下半年需留意燃油價格波動，以及機隊交付延遲對運能擴張的限制。

en.title: IATA: June passenger demand up 8.2%, Asia-Pacific leads at 11.6%
en.summary: RPKs rose 8.2% year on year with load factor at a June-record 84.9%.
body: IATA data show June global passenger demand (RPK) up 8.2% year on year, led by Asia-Pacific at 11.6%; load factor reached 84.9%, a June record.

International demand grew 9.4%, strongest across the transpacific, while domestic markets rose 5.1%. IATA flagged fuel-price volatility and delivery delays as the constraints to watch in the second half.
